sources.title: Introducing GPT-5 for developers
sources.evidence: August 7, 2025 announcement explicitly launches gpt-5 in the API that day. Identifies the API model as the reasoning model, separate from ChatGPT routing and gpt-5-chat-latest. Documents configurable reasoning effort, function/custom tools, and three named API size tiers without numerical parameter counts.

sources.title: GPT-5 model documentation
sources.evidence: Complete Markdown fetched. Exact alias defaults to gpt-5-2025-08-07; documents 400,000 context, 272,000 maximum input, 128,000 maximum output, text/image inputs, text output, reasoning tokens, function calling, file uploads and prompt caching. Alias and snapshot are Deprecated, not shut down.

sources.title: File inputs
sources.evidence: Complete Markdown fetched. PDF ingestion is supported on vision-capable models and sends extracted text plus page images to the model. Combined with exact GPT-5 image-input, file-upload and Responses support, this establishes PDF as an API document format rather than a native sensory modality.

sources.title: OpenAI API deprecations
sources.evidence: June 11, 2026 notice explicitly lists gpt-5 and gpt-5-2025-08-07 for shutdown December 11, 2026. This is scheduled retirement, not evidence of completed shutdown or an endpoint runtime check.

sources.title: OpenAI Services Agreement
sources.evidence: Current terms effective January 1, 2026 apply to API services; sections 2.2 and 9.1 grant limited use and reserve service intellectual property. Supports descriptive Proprietary classification of hosted access, not a downloadable-weight license or a claim these exact terms governed the August 2025 launch.

sources.title: All models
sources.evidence: Current indexed official catalog separates the hosted GPT-5 entry from the open-weight category, which explicitly lists gpt-oss models under Apache 2.0. Read with the API launch and service terms; no GPT-5 checkpoint download is supplied.

sources.title: GPT-5 System Card
sources.evidence: Full PDF downloaded and text-extracted. Introduction identifies gpt-5-thinking as the API reasoning model; training section describes reinforcement learning and internal chain of thought. Checked production architecture/parameter references and comparison tables; no total or active parameter count or routing structure is disclosed. ChatGPT system routing is not internal mixture-of-experts architecture.

sources.title: From Hard Refusals to Safe-Completions: Toward Output-Centric Safety Training
sources.evidence: Full PDF downloaded and text-extracted. Section 3.1 distinguishes production GPT-5 Thinking (gpt5-r) from o3 and from o4-mini-like controlled experiments. It says production models differ in architecture but supplies no exact GPT-5 structural or parameter specification; controlled-model attributes are not transferred.

sources.title: GPT-5.1 Instant and GPT-5.1 Thinking System Card Addendum
sources.evidence: Later November 12, 2025 card downloaded and text-extracted. Its comparisons explicitly include gpt-5-thinking, but the columns give safety evaluation scores, not production sizes or architecture. No exact GPT-5 parameter count or routing disclosure found.

sources.title: Prompt Caching 201
sources.evidence: Complete Markdown fetched. Archived guide applies to models before GPT-5.6 and explains OpenAI prompt caching through Transformer attention layers and stored key/value tensors. The exact GPT-5 model page explicitly supports prompt caching. Their conjunction supports broad Transformer attention as an operational inference, without asserting a complete layer inventory or dense/MoE routing; table examples for nano and GPT-5.2 are not transferred.

sources.title: Studying metagaming latents in language models
sources.evidence: Later interpretability research was checked because it mentions GPT-5. Its internal residual-stream/SAE experiments study an o3 reinforcement-learning run; GPT-5 is only the grader. These findings do not disclose GPT-5 architecture or parameter counts.

sources.title: Learning Powerful Models: From Transformers to Reasoners and Beyond
sources.evidence: October 8, 2025 official researcher talk describes current GPT decoder attention and reasoning-token computation within Transformer context, naming GPT-5 among reasoners. This is broad corroborating context, not a snapshot-specific architecture report or a parameter disclosure; the operational architecture inference rests on s2 and s10.

name.note: Official API model name; this record is not the ChatGPT multi-model system or gpt-5-chat-latest.

developer.note: OpenAI publishes and releases the exact API model.

family.note: The developer launch groups gpt-5, mini and nano within GPT-5; normalize the specific family instead of generic gpt.

release_date.note: Dated first-party launch explicitly makes the API model available that day; the matching immutable snapshot corroborates identity.

open_weights.note: Hosted proprietary API release with no public checkpoint distribution; official model catalog distinguishes the separate open-weight offerings.

license.note: Descriptive classification of closed service/model access, not an SPDX checkpoint license.

parameters_b.note: No numerical total production parameter count found in the release, exact specifications, original card, training paper or later GPT-5.1 comparison card. Named size tiers, other models and safety-system components do not quantify this model.

active_parameters_b.note: No active parameter count per token or internal expert-routing specification is disclosed. Do not equate active with total or mistake ChatGPT model routing for MoE routing.

architecture.note: Broad classification is an explicit cross-source operational inference: exact GPT-5 supports prompt caching, and the applicable pre-GPT-5.6 guide describes that mechanism as Transformer attention with key/value tensors. This does not establish an exhaustive block inventory, exclusively Transformer layers, dense/MoE feed-forward routing or counts. The researcher talk is corroborating context only.

context_window.note: Exact total context is 400,000 tokens. Maximum input 272,000 and maximum output 128,000 are separately documented limits, not alternative context values or binary expansions.

modalities.note: Native inputs are text/image and output text. PDF is added under the catalog supported-API-file convention: extracted text and page images are passed to the model. Hosted image-generation tools do not imply native image output.

reasoning.note: Exact API release is the thinking model with internal reasoning-token support and minimal/low/medium/high effort settings. Minimal remains a reasoning setting and is distinct from the non-reasoning chat model.

tool_call.note: Launch and model documentation explicitly support function calling and custom tools; not inferred merely from generic agentic benchmarks.

description.value: Reasoning model with text and image input, text output, a 400,000-token context window and function calling.
description.note: Replace workhorse framing with directly documented behavior and capacity, without unsupported size or current-best claims.

patch.notes: The gpt-5 alias defaults to gpt-5-2025-08-07, the reasoning API model released August 7, 2025; it is distinct from ChatGPT routing and gpt-5-chat-latest. Context is 400,000 tokens, with separate 272,000 maximum input and 128,000 maximum output limits. PDF files are processed into text and page images. Broad Transformer attention is inferred from exact-model prompt-caching support and its documented mechanism; complete structure, dense/MoE routing and total/active parameter counts remain undisclosed. OpenAI schedules this alias and snapshot for API shutdown December 11, 2026; no live endpoint request was made.

summary: Verified the original GPT-5 reasoning API model and all 14 fields. Corrected family, license and description; added operationally supported broad Transformer classification and PDF API input. Confirmed exact context, tools and reasoning support, separated the model from ChatGPT routing, and documented scheduled retirement. Production counts and dense/MoE routing remain undisclosed after original and later research checks.
